A. R-S-R: This is a sulfide (or thioether), where the sulfur atom is bonded to two carbon groups.
B. R-S-S-R: This is a disulfide, where two sulfur atoms are bonded together and each is also bonded to a carbon group.
C. R-SH: This shows a sulfur atom bonded to both a hydrogen atom and a carbon group, which is the definition of a thiol.
D. R2S: This is another way to write R-S-R, which is a sulfide.
